title: N-Body simulation
summary: Advance the Jovian planets 1,000,000 steps with a symplectic integrator.
description: Classic five-body gravitational simulation (Sun, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune) from the Computer Language Benchmarks Game. Each step computes pairwise forces and advances positions with a fixed time step of 0.01. The program prints the system energy before and after with 9 decimals.
reveals: Scalar floating-point throughput, loop optimisation and (where the compiler can) auto-vectorisation.
caveat: Result depends on iteration count, precision and compiler math flags. We forbid fast-math and FMA contraction so every language must produce the identical 9-digit energies.
